title: Father's bands: Sam Morgan, Wooden Joe, Superior, Olympia
summary: Eddie says his father quit and turned the band over to Sam Morgan, disputes that Wooden Joe played with him, and lists his father's bands, including Superior, Empire and Olympia with Bunk Johnson.
